request: In the TextTools library (src/TextTools/TextTools.cs), add a public static method TextTools.Slugify(string value) that converts text into a URL slug.
steps: Add Slugify to the existing TextTools class without changing Reverse.
Add xUnit tests for Slugify to tests/TextTools.Tests.
Build and test the solution with --no-restore.
acceptanceCriteria: TextTools.Slugify("Hello, World!") returns "hello-world": ASCII letters and digits are lowercased, every run of other characters becomes a single hyphen, and leading and trailing hyphens are removed.
TextTools.Slugify(null) throws ArgumentNullException, and input with no letters or digits (for example "  --!! ") returns an empty string.
New xUnit tests in tests/TextTools.Tests cover every case above, the existing Reverse tests still pass, and dotnet test reports no failures.
optionalCriteria: Slugify has an XML documentation comment.
